text:
marta: heads-up — a few new users hitting onboarding sampleapp report scrambled message order + duplicate terminal events when token refresh happens mid-stream. repros on browser + mobile.
ben: can you paste a minimal repro/logs?
marta: steps: open sampleapp -> start streaming -> force refresh at ~35s. sometimes UI shows parts in wrong order and two `[END]` markers. logs: 
[2026-03-25T11:05:00Z] sse: connected
[2026-03-25T11:05:35Z] auth: refresh start
[2026-03-25T11:05:35Z] sse: recv seq=77 data="first"
[2026-03-25T11:05:35Z] sse: recv seq=78 data="second"
[2026-03-25T11:05:35Z] client: parse error: unexpected "\n"
[2026-03-25T11:05:35Z] client: reconnect last_event_id=78
[2026-03-25T11:05:35Z] sse: recv seq=78 data="second" // duplicate
[2026-03-25T11:05:35Z] sse: recv seq=79 data="third" // arrives after duplicate -> UI order wrong
olivia: parity issue: web sampleapp aborts the XHR on refresh; mobile waits. also our SDKs differ: web emits on each `data:` line, mobile emits on full event delim.
ben: so three problems: abort-vs-wait race, parser semantics mismatch, and no client dedupe.
olivia: fix plan:
- change sampleapps to avoid aborting inflight on refresh; set a header on next connect to resume instead.
- standardize SSE parser across sdks to emit only on full event boundary (headers + blank line).
- add short dedupe window (2s) keyed by event id, fallback to checksum.
- server ticket to ensure resume handshake doesn't re-emit final event.
qa-bot: created ticket DEX-998: sse-resume-ordering + INF-4312 for server-side resume atomicity.
ben: add telemetry `sse.resume.duplicate{sdk}` and a staging smoke test that forces refresh at 30s.
marta: small UX tweak for onboarding: show helper text "Streams may briefly reconnect while credentials refresh; content will be deduped." reduces support noise.
dploy-bot: staging rollout queued for branch/sse-onboard-parity-fix — ETA 15m.
ben: i'll open PRs: web sampleapp change + unit tests, sdk parser normalization, and client dedupe in both js/python sdks. olivia: i'll coordinate mobile patch.
marta: thanks — closing for now, will reopen if staging metrics spike. :white_check_mark:
